author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: rounded camera body with a trapezoid prism hump centred over a large round lens, and a short strap line on the left wall; reads as a retro photo camera. The rejected drawing had a jagged double-bump top and a tiny lens.
omissions: The reference's small shutter block beside the hump and the inner lens ring are dropped: neither fits with 8-unit clearances at 48.
drawing_plan: SQUARE body x 6..42, y 12..42 with r4 corners; hump 16..36 rising to y 6; lens r7 at (26,26); side line (6,21)-(11,21).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'camera': rounded body with a raised top section and a circle lens.
